key: e:mine health and safety regulations 8.10.1.2 b and 8.10.2.1 b
synopsis: South Africa's Mine Health and Safety Regulations 8.10.1.2(b) and 8.10.2.1(b) were published on 27 February 2015 and commenced on 21 December 2022 under Notice 2908, Government Gazette 47790, with no transitional period [f1363, f2078, f612]. Their scope includes surface and underground trackless mobile machinery; for diesel-powered trackless mobile machines, they require retardation to a safe speed followed by automatic brake application if no action is taken to prevent a potential collision [f4337, f1361, f5162]. The collision-intervention system must also “fail to safe” without human intervention [f1362, f5163]. A vendor finding attributes suppliers' deployment and subsequent on-site refinement of collision-intervention systems to commencement without a transitional period, highlighting an implementation pressure rather than disagreement over the commencement date or requirements [f613, f612].
